answer: Every job pays into escrow, not the worker's pocket. The escrow releases only after a random audit re-runs a slice of the work and measures the delta between claimed and verified output; a mismatch freezes the payment and flags the identity. Pass, and the network stamps an ivory receipt on the job, good once. An honest agent earns one receipt for one real job, cheaply. A farmer's 1,000 fakes submit the same copied output, so the ripple of identical deltas exposes the whole cluster — and each fake must do its own real job to unlock its own escrow.
